messages:
tess: Hey team, FinScale's procurement needs an assurance packet for the POC: redacted SOC2, ISO27001 summary, and a signed pen-test attestation. Timeline: they want it before the legal review on Thursday. Can we meet that?
noah: We can. I can attach SOC2 redacted and ISO summary. Who owns the attestation?
paul: Security here. We can sign a scoped attestation limited to production inference endpoints only. Need confirmation if the vendor will share a report (redacted ok) and sign NDA. Require 30-day remediation.
ravi: Legal ok with language; include no-implied-warranty clause and scope limitation. Also require vendor contact info + test dates.
security-bot: Uploaded SOC2 redacted: s3://redwood-evidence/finscale/poc/soc2-redacted-2026-03.pdf (sha256: ghi789)
noah: Asked procurement: vendor will provide a redacted report only and refuses to share raw. They sent vendor contact info.
paul: Acceptable if vendor confirms scope and methodology. We'll request the vendor to email security@redwood-inference.com and sign NDA.
tess: Draft of the attestation proposed below; feedback?

```
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference confirms that [Vendor] performed a penetration test against Redwoods production inference endpoints in scope: [redacted]. The vendor report will be provided to Redwood under NDA; a redacted copy may be shared with the customer. Redwood will remediate documented findings within 30 days of disclosure, subject to severity and operational constraints. This attestation is limited to the named scope and does not constitute any warranty. For questions contact security@redwood-inference.com.
```
noah: LGTM. Paul pls post final attestation to S3 once signed.
paul: Will do. Owner: Paul (security). Due: Wed COB.
legal: Also attach SOC2 issue date: 2025-11-15 and redact ISO cert number.
noah: I'll assemble the 1-pager timeline and include host inventory once ops produces it.
security-bot: Host inventory available: s3://redwood-evidence/finscale/poc/host-list-redacted.csv
tess: Thanks everyone, I'll update FinScale procurement and ask for vendor NDA + confirmation of test dates. :thumbsup:
